newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPC rises on news of Korean interest.
newsitem.headline: IPC rises on news of Korean interest.

text.p: Shares of computer firm IPC Corporation rose 3.85 percent, or two Singapore cents, to S$0.54 on news of its sale of some shares to a South Korean group, dealers said on Wednesday.

IPC said on Tuesday it had offered 66 million shares at S$0.60 each, amounting to six percent of the company, to Sungwoo Group. The shares are priced at a premium over IPC's current traded share price.
"The shares are up because of the Korean interest," said a dealer with a local firm.
IPC chairman Patrick Ngiam said the deal would help the company reposition itself in South Korea.
IPC's unit in South Korean was reported to have defaulted on promisary notes in late January.
